name: UPES Online

about.text: University of Petroleum and Energy Studies (UPES) was established in 2003. UPES is the division that provides degree courses in the online mode. The university is approved by UGC-DEB to offer courses in the online learning mode.

UPES Online is approved by UGC-DEB to offer online degree courses. It has also been accredited by NAAC and maintains all the standards and guidelines laid down by the Centre for Internal Quality Assurance (CIQA).

The university aims to help working professionals upgrade their professional skills and knowledge. The programs offered by UPES Online are focused on industry domains and specializations that are rapidly growing and are high in demand. The university focuses on the domains of energy, health & industrial safety, high-end IT solutions, logistics & supply chain, among others.

about.text: UPES Online has 5500+ alumni working not just in India but across 17 countries with top organizations. The university through its courses and cutting-edge curriculum helps students and working professionals enter into core industry domain areas and the emerging sectors of the economy.

The learning methodology of UPES mainly includes self-learning through the study material provided by the college like e-books, recorded videos, papers, journals, pdfs, and more. The university has designed the curriculum in a way that is flexible which makes it easier for working professionals to learn, network, and grow.

facts: UPES Online is UGC-DEB approved and NAAC accredited.
The university offers courses in the blended online learning mode.
The online courses offered by UPES Online are in the Management domains with various unique specializations.
UPES Online offers skilling programs in the domains of Science and technology, Management, and especially Energy Studies.
For Self-Learning Management (SLM), the university provides e-learning content in the form of pdf, e-books, papers & journals, recorded videos, and much more.
There are live interaction sessions as well conducted by the experienced faculty of UPES and professionals from relevant industries.

emi.text: Many colleges and universities today offer various payment options to make it easier for students to pay their course fees, including education loan schemes with convenient EMI installments. While UPES does not provide such payment options directly, there is a platform called College Vidya Portal that helps students secure admission to the university and pay their academic fees through easy EMI installments. College Vidya is an unbiased online platform for online and distance education, offering flexible payment solutions for students.

examination.text: The examinations at UPES Online are conducted in the online mode and are monitored and proctored live through various AI services.
Examination Pattern: 30% Internal Assessment (assignments, quizzes) + 70% End-Term Exam. All exams conducted online in remote proctored mode via the CodeTantra platform. Semester-based system.

faqs.q: Can I pursue two degree courses at the same time?
faqs.a: No, as per the regulations of the university, students can not pursue two degree courses at the same time. However, the students can pursue one degree program and one short-term online course at the same time.

faqs.q: Is UPES Online learning approved by UGC?
faqs.a: Yes, UPES Online has been approved by UGC and UGC-DEB to offer courses in online mode.

faqs.q: Is UPES accredited by NAAC and ranked by NIRF?
faqs.a: Yes, UPES has NAAC accreditation and has been ranked by NIRF among the top 100 universities. The Business School of UPES has been ranked 41 by NIRF.

faqs.q: Are faculty members available other than live classes?
faqs.a: Yes, you can reach the faculty on any day (except Monday) other than weekend live classes by booking a time slot in advance with the particular faculty member you wish to consult. You can go to the Help Desk and raise a ticket or request your program manager.

faqs.q: Are short-term skilling programs UGC approved?
faqs.a: The short-term skilling programs need not be specifically approved by UGC, instead, they need to be approved by the Internal Statutory Body of the University.

faqs.q: What are the top part-time courses offered by government-approved universities in India?
faqs.a: After addressing the time commitment issues of working professionals & regular students, government-recognized universities have introduced a convenient format of courses at their portal in the name of Part-Time Courses. faqs.q: Is there a fixed duration for online UG and PG courses?
faqs.a: Every course has a minimum and maximum time period between which the students can complete the program. For undergraduate programs, the minimum duration is 3 years and the maximum duration is 5 years. For postgraduate programs, the minimum duration is 2 years and the maximum duration is 4 years.
